title: ai1 watch
description: How something shipped to production is checked (.ai1/watches/<id>.json, committed). Who follows it and the results live in each person's ignored .ai1/local/.

title.description: What is followed, in a few words.

kind.description: command: run by `ai1 watch run`. agent: a prompt the agent follows when the person says yes, recorded with `ai1 watch record`.

run.description: The command. A list of arguments runs without a shell (works the same on every platform); a string runs with the platform's shell.

prompt.description: For kind agent: what the agent checks and how.

expect.description: { "exitCode": n }: each run is ok or fail. "counts": the last line of the output is JSON { "succeeded": n, "failed": m } for the events since AI1_WATCH_SINCE (ISO date in the command's environment); ai1 adds them up since the subscription started.

every.description: Suggested time between checks; a subscription may set its own.

suggestedFor.description: How long a new subscription follows it by default.

createdBy.description: Git email of who wrote it.
